narrative:
Greene County has 119,423 registered voters, with 16.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 30.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 46.1%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 15.3 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 27.3% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -3.2% D−R vs -26.1% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
